camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateHost --region cn-hangzhou --Comment Local_Host --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --InstanceMemberId 1605494 --SourceInstanceId 'i-dfabfda' --Source Local --ActiveAddressType Public --HostPrivateAddress '192.168.XX.XX' --InstanceRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostPublicAddress '172.16.XX.XX' --OSType Linux --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostName host01 --NetworkDomainId 1
description_en: Creates a host in a Bastionhost instance. You can import Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances, on-premises servers, and third-party cloud servers as hosts for centralized O&M management
description_zh: 堡垒机支持运维阿里云ECS服务器、线下IDC服务器以及其他云上服务器等不同来源的主机。在通过堡垒机运维主机之前，首先需要在堡垒机中导入主机。您可以参考本接口在堡垒机中创建需要运维的主机
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-private-address 192.168.XX.XX --host-public-address 172.16.XX.XX --active-address-type Public --host-name host01 --source Local --os-type Linux --comment Local_Host --source-instance-id i-dfabfda --instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 1 --instance-member-id 1605494 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHost

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机所在堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The private address of the host. You can use a domain name or an IP address.

This parameter is required when ActiveAddressType is set to Private
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的私网地址，可使用域名或IP地址。
ActiveAddressType选择Private时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: host_private_address

parameters.help_en:
The public address of the host. You can use a domain name or an IP address.

This parameter is required when ActiveAddressType is set to Public
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的公网地址，可使用域名或IP地址。
ActiveAddressType选择Public时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: host_public_address

parameters.help_en:
The address type of the host. Valid values:

Public: a public address

Private: a private address
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的地址类型。取值：
Public：公网地址
Private：私网地址
parameters.name: active_address_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the host. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建主机的名称，最多支持128字符
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en:
The source of the host. Valid values:

Local: a local host

Ecs: an ECS instance

Rds: a host in an ApsaraDB RDS dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的来源。取值：
Local：本地主机
Ecs：ECS实例
Rds：RDS专属集群主机
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the host. Valid values:

Linux

Windows
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机的操作系统。取值：
Linux
Windows
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The comment for the host. The comment can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定主机的备注信息，最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the ECS instance or the host in the dedicated cluster.

This parameter is required when Source is set to Ecs or Rds
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建的ECS实例ID或专属集群主机ID。  
Source选择Ecs或Rds时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the ECS instance or the host in the dedicated cluster.

This parameter is required when Source is set to Ecs or Rds
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建的ECS实例或专属集群主机所属区域ID。  
Source选择Ecs或Rds时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network domain to which the host belongs.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.htmloperation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建主机所属的网络域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECS instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建的ECS实例所属的主账号ID
parameters.name: instance_member_id
